# Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3

Mistral · released 2024-05 · 7.25B params · apache-2.0

**score 38.1** ±1.3 · #421 of 551 · from 14 benchmark results across 9 sources

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<sub>[context source](https://docs.mistral.ai/models/mistral-7b-0-3): Context limit from the maker's documentation, observed 2026-10-06.</sub>

<pre>
download         size  score
4-bit q4_k_m  ~4.85GB   38.1
8-bit q8_0     ~9.2GB   38.1
</pre>

```sh
# 4-bit q4_k_m
ollama run mistral:7b-instruct-v0.3-q4_K_M
# 8-bit q8_0
ollama run mistral:7b-instruct-v0.3-q8_0
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
